workspace.title: MDM2 peptide discovery
workspace.direction: Characterize five N8 substitutions with PMI and PMI-N8A as controls.

overview.question: What did we learn about these peptides, and what should we test next?
paragraphs: We have **five new hypotheses at PMI position 8**, with their predicted binding modes preserved. We haven’t measured whether any of them bind more tightly.
**N8S** has the closest shared backbone to the reference among the new proposals. Here is its predicted complex with MDM2.
overview.caution: **The local geometry still needs caution.** N8S changes a reference contact. Three other proposals show severe local clashes, and so does the known PMI positive control.
overview.next: The next useful step is experimental binding and functional characterization of the shortlist, with the published peptides as controls.

t-5d410af4742b.question: Can a native single-position search propose chemically distinct N8 substitutions while preserving the PMI contact scaffold?
t-5d410af4742b.result: 300 proposals; 239 passed the authored filter, giving 16 distinct substitutions. The pool is unranked. PMI-N8A remains a published control.
t-5d410af4742b.note: The cysteine exclusion was an authored conservative choice, not an established chemistry limitation. See the later review.
t-5d410af4742b.caption: 16 distinct substitutions · native Proto

t-c9bc2c567363.question: Do the five new proposals preserve the published PMI binding mode against the exact MDM2 domain?
t-c9bc2c567363.result: Seven complexes were saved with exact chain mapping, native CIFs, and complete 97 × 97 PAE matrices. Structural diagnostics support further investigation; they do not establish affinity.
t-c9bc2c567363.note: One predictor, one seed, use_msa=False. Local geometry errors also occur in the PMI positive control.
t-c9bc2c567363.caption: 5 proposals + 2 controls · Boltz2

t-bcc6f3060f15.question: Can shared-position structural comparison recover valid RMSD measurements for the mutated sequences?
t-bcc6f3060f15.result: The captured analysis fixed the original sequence-matching limitation using the previously saved structures. N8S has the lowest shared-position RMSD among the new proposals. No new prediction was run.
t-bcc6f3060f15.note: The 2 Å cutoff was chosen after exploratory analysis of these structures. The later operator note qualifies it as post-hoc.
t-bcc6f3060f15.caption: Sequence-aware analysis · CPU
